Type: deco
Name: Stone & Beam Modern Farmhouse Wood and Galvanized Metal Decor Storage Bin Basket, 14 Inch, White Washed (Renewed)
This clean, crisp storage bin will boost your style while concealing clutter or storing treasured items.  With white-washed wood on the outside, galvanized metal on the inside and hemp ropes for handles, this piece will blend with most any décor. 14"D x 14"W x 10"H This bin looks attractive on a shelf, or out in full view as a catch-all for clutter Fir wood, engineered wood, galvanized metal, hemp rope For indoor use
